messages.author: 4364ce565c0e42d1
messages.subject: Exploring high-dimensional posterior
parts:
Hey all, 
I was wondering if anyone has any experience using Nimble for exploring high dimensional (n > 500) posteriors. I was more interested in knowing what sort of sampler would you suggest ? or if there is any need for modifying the samplers ?
Thanks

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Exploring high-dimensional posterior
parts:
Dear Hamze,

In general, 500 dimensions shouldn't be a problem.  People often write models with thousands of dimensions for MCMC sampling due to many latent states.

Performance of samplers really depends on the model and the data.  A good strategy would be to see how nimble's default samplers do and then decide if improving performance is worth your effort.

-Perry
